zh: 深入開展標的研究與市場分析，敏銳追蹤產業趨勢並挖掘價值標的。
en: Research tracks industry trends and identifies promising assets.

zh: 連接傳統資產與鏈上生態，串聯代幣發行與申贖全流程。
en: Links assets to on-chain issuance, subscriptions and redemptions.

zh: 協同頂級做市商提供流動性，持續雙邊報價保障交易深度。
en: Top market makers provide two-way quotes and order-book depth.

zh: 香港持牌券商託管資產，配合鏈上鏈下持倉核對。
en: HK licensed broker custody with on- and off-chain holdings reconciled.

zh: 實現一級市場 T0 申贖交收³，支持二級市場 24/7 交易。
en: Supports T0 primary settlement³ and 24/7 secondary trading.

copy.zh: 相較永續合約，本產品不收取資金費。可配合永續合約對沖策略，尋找潛在資金費套利機會；實際結果取決於資金費率、對沖安排及相關成本。
copy.en: Unlike perpetual contracts, this product charges no funding fee. Hedging with perpetual contracts may create funding-fee arbitrage opportunities. Outcomes depend on funding rates, hedges and costs.

copy.zh: 7709.HK 單位由合規持牌券商託管，以實際持倉提供 1:1 支持。
copy.en: 7709.HK units are held in custody by a licensed broker, with actual holdings providing 1:1 backing.

title.en: Deep Order Books by Top Market Makers

copy.zh: 全球領先做市商全天候提供買賣報價，維持訂單簿深度。二級市場透過訂單簿形成交易價格。
copy.en: Leading global market makers provide buy and sell quotes around the clock to maintain order-book depth. Secondary-market prices are formed through the order book.

copy.zh: 投資者可直接透過錢包在支持的二級市場交易，毋須開立券商帳戶。
copy.en: Investors can trade on supported secondary markets directly from their wallets without opening a brokerage account.

T0 may occur in or outside Hong Kong market hours, subject to reliable valuation and settlement; otherwise it is deferred. Secondary token trading takes place 24/7 on third-party venues. Off-hours prices are indicative.
